onnx.runs: for case in providers inference shape input; do python3.15 onnx-check.py "$case"; done

onnx-minilm.runs:
set -eu
root=/usr/share/onnx/minilm-l6-v2/onnx
test "$(wc -c <"$root/model.onnx")" -gt 1000000
test "$(wc -c <"$root/vocab.txt")" -gt 1000
for name in config.json tokenizer.json tokenizer_config.json special_tokens_map.json; do
  python3.15 -m json.tool "$root/$name" >/dev/null
done

suricata.runs:
suricata -V | grep -F '${{package.version}}'
suricata --build-info
test -f /etc/suricata/suricata.yaml
test -f /usr/share/suricata/classification.config
test -f /usr/share/suricata/reference.config
test -f /usr/share/suricata/rules/decoder-events.rules

wordpress-sqlite.runs:
plugin=/usr/src/wordpress/wp-content/plugins/sqlite-database-integration
php -l /usr/src/wordpress/wp-content/db.php
find "$plugin" -name '*.php' -exec php -l '{}' ';'
test -s "$plugin/wp-includes/sqlite/db.php"
grep -F '${{package.version}}' "$plugin/load.php"
! grep -E '\{SQLITE_(PLUGIN|IMPLEMENTATION_FOLDER_PATH)\}' /usr/src/wordpress/wp-content/db.php
php -r '$db=new PDO("sqlite::memory:"); if ($db->query("select 42")->fetchColumn()!=42) exit(1);'
